name: Sakaki Mutsumi
source:
Mutsumi is the Vice Captain of the Track Club. She's always restless and shooting for the seat of the next club captain. Mutsumi calls [url=/c98600]San[/url] "Boss Lady" and [url=/c98390]Mitsuru[/url] "Boss" out of respect for them. She also loves apples.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
